'''Thaddeus Aid''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 112 from Mountain View, Ca. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
